evidence: our ability to assess and monitor the effects of artificial intelligence on our business and operations
New developments in the fields of generative artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, and robotics may create new vulnerabilities and cybersecurity risks
Cybersecurity failures may be caused by employee error, malfeasance, other corporate or governmental actors, system errors or vulnerabilities
ai_positioning.summary: WMS adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, se concentrant sur les risques cybersécurité liés aux développements en IA générative et machine learning plutôt que sur des initiatives d'intégration ou de leadership technologique.
